name: GFX_hof_ic_smirnov_the_fifth_army
title: 第五集团军与五军将士
concept: A diagonal column of five early Russian civil-war soldiers marching away to the RIGHT into a first-snow plain, seen strictly from behind, backpacks and puttees, rifles slung on shoulders, no faces or facial features. Cohesive marching silhouettes, small distant village and smoke, cold brown-grey ivory relief. No combat, no wounded.
prompt: Create ONE Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon matching reference outer frame and sculpted engraved relief finish but replace ALL central objects with this miniature landscape: A diagonal column of five early Russian civil-war soldiers marching away to the RIGHT into a first-snow plain, seen strictly from behind, backpacks and puttees, rifles slung on shoulders, no faces or facial features. Cohesive marching silhouettes, small distant village and smoke, cold brown-grey ivory relief. No combat, no wounded. Use antique GOLD laurel branches open at top, small red star above and blank gold ribbon below, thin deep crimson medallion rim. Interior scene primarily ivory and grey bas-relief with restrained specified color tints; scene is an embossed miniature landscape, not a photograph. Retain some deep red around interior scene edges for series unity. Strong upper-left relief light and readable silhouettes at 100x88 pixels. No readable text, letters, numbers, watermark, faces or leader portraits. Landscape aspect 100:88, emblem fills 94% of canvas. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND ENABLED: RGBA PNG actual alpha=0 outside isolated emblem, four corners transparent, transparent area 20-50%. No checkerboard, no solid rectangle, no outer shadow.
